in_marathi.name: Jadu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jadu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Jadu means 'magic' or 'illusion'. It is derived from the verb 'jad' which means 'to bewitch' or 'to enchant'. In Hindu mythology, Jadu is often associated with magical powers and the supernatural.
